camera.motion: static (frame 0 vs 49 mean abs diff in sky/house ~2-4 grey levels = compression noise)
camera.view: frontal, horizontal; horse walks parallel to the image plane, house facade faces camera
camera.ground_horizon_y_px: grass/sky line ~988-995 at image left (x<250); house base ~1040

horse.occluded: never (fully in frame, in front of house)
horse.description: single chestnut (orange-brown) horse with white socks and a pale/grey face, side view, walking LEFT->RIGHT in front of the house's left ground floor; faces right
horse.track: tracks/horse.csv (ref_x/ref_y = trunk midpoint, torso template chain); keyframes tracks/horse_keyframes.csv

displacement_px.vertical: ref_y within +-2 px (walk on flat ground)

house.description: two-storey half-timbered house, brick ground floor with 3 arched windows, upper storey with central wooden door/shutter and 2 small shutters, gable roof; centred in frame behind the horse
house.reliability: +-5 px, read on a 10 px grid

red_flowers.description: small red flowers in the foreground grass

grass_field.description: grass foreground from y~990 to bottom; distant grass hills at left

events.horse_motion: walking throughout frames 0-49 (already moving at frame 0, still moving at 49); no start/stop, no direction change; gait gives a step-to-step oscillation of the torso x-step (~2.5-4.5 px/frame)
